load_tfds_dataset: load a TensorFlow dataset by name using tfds.load with split and shuffle settings
list_available_datasets: list all available TensorFlow dataset builders with tfds.list_builders
create_even_data_splits: create even train/test data splits from a dataset using tfds.even_splits
show_dataset_examples: display sample examples and statistics from a TensorFlow dataset using tfds.show_examples and tfds.show_statistics
benchmark_dataset_loading: benchmark the performance of loading and iterating over a TensorFlow dataset using tfds.benchmark
